caption: The drawing depicts a doll with pale skin and light brown, wavy hair styled close to the head. The doll is dressed in a simple, off-white dress with short sleeves and a gathered waist, and the dress reaches down to the doll's lower legs. The doll has blue eyes and slightly parted lips. Both arms are bent at the elbow and the hands are resting in its lap, with each finger carefully outlined. The doll is wearing high, bright red buttoned boots, which have white buttons and a pronounced heel. The figure appears to be seated against a plain, beige background with no other objects or decorative elements in the composition. The overall color palette consists of neutral beige and white tones for the doll and background, with the exception of its brown hair, blue eyes, and vivid red boots.
title: Doll--"Nina"
